title: Spectra of $1/k$-Contractions via Characteristic Functions
summary: A unitarily invariant complete Nevanlinna--Pick (CNP) kernel $k$ on the Euclidean ball gives rise to a natural class of operator tuples on Hilbert spaces, known as $1/k$-contractions. We establish a lower estimate for the Taylor joint spectrum of $1/k$-contractions with finite defect in terms of the associated characteristic function. Under the additional assumption that $k$ satisfies the Corona property, this lower estimate coincides with an upper estimate due to Clouâtre--Timko [Adv.
